description: Create a purchase intent for a product. Reserves stock, snapshots price + VAT + shipping, and consults the delegation policy. Returns an intent id; intents expire after 15 minutes if not confirmed. Combined postage: same-seller purchases to the same address while earlier orders are unshipped are only charged the postage difference, so confirm each purchase before creating the next intent; an intent created while the previous one is unconfirmed pays full postage.

address_id.description: UUID of a saved shipping address; defaults to the buyer's default address.

payment_method_id.description: UUID of a saved payment method owned by the buyer; defaults to the buyer's default card.

product_id.description: UUID of the product to purchase.
